# Shared cases: where the queue's current track lands after a move.
#
# Replayed by both implementations, so they cannot drift apart:
#   - native/linthra_core/src/queue_moves_cases_test.rs (Rust)
#   - test/core/models/queue_moves_cases_test.dart (Dart)
#
# One case per line, fields separated by a single TAB. `#` starts a comment.
#
#   <length>  <current>  <move>  <index>  <new current>
#
# current:     position of the current track, -1 for an empty queue
# move:        next | previous | restart | moveTo | jumpToUpNext | jumpToHistory
# index:       the move's argument (moveTo: into the queue, jumpToUpNext: into
#              up next, jumpToHistory: into history), or - when it takes none
# new current: the new position, or - when the move does nothing

3	0	next	-	1
3	2	next	-	-
1	0	next	-	-
0	-1	next	-	-
3	1	previous	-	0
3	0	previous	-	-
1	0	previous	-	-
0	-1	previous	-	-
3	2	restart	-	0
1	0	restart	-	0
0	-1	restart	-	-
3	0	moveTo	2	2
3	1	moveTo	1	1
3	0	moveTo	3	-
3	1	moveTo	-1	-
0	-1	moveTo	0	-
3	0	jumpToUpNext	1	2
5	1	jumpToUpNext	2	4
3	1	jumpToUpNext	0	2
3	0	jumpToUpNext	2	-
3	2	jumpToUpNext	0	-
3	0	jumpToUpNext	-1	-
0	-1	jumpToUpNext	0	-
3	2	jumpToHistory	0	0
3	2	jumpToHistory	1	1
5	4	jumpToHistory	3	3
3	2	jumpToHistory	2	-
3	0	jumpToHistory	0	-
3	1	jumpToHistory	-1	-
0	-1	jumpToHistory	0	-
